home.title: Welcome, {{name}}
home.subtitle: Alice keeps track of your TLS certificates and SSH keys.
home.serverUnreachable: The server cannot be reached right now. Try reloading the page in a minute.

nav.label: Main navigation
nav.signOutFailed: Could not sign you out. Try again.
nav.setupBanner: Finish setting up: choose a recovery passphrase.
nav.setupBannerFinish: Finish setting up: open the setup wizard to confirm the last step.
nav.setupBannerLicense: Finish setting up: add a license or start the evaluation.

ui.noAccess: You do not have access to this page.
ui.networkErrorAction: Check your network connection and try again.
ui.notFoundText: The address may be mistyped, or the page was moved.
ui.usernameHelp: 2 to 64 characters: English letters (A–Z), digits, dot, underscore or hyphen. Start with a letter or digit.

stepUp.title: Confirm it's you
stepUp.help: For your security, enter the current code from your authenticator app.

totp.title: Set up your authenticator app
totp.help: Scan this QR code with an authenticator app such as Microsoft Authenticator or Google Authenticator. Then type the 6-digit code the app shows.
totp.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
totp.manual: Cannot scan the code? Type this key into the app instead:

recoveryCodes.title: Save your recovery codes
recoveryCodes.help: If you lose your phone, each of these codes lets you sign in once. Keep them somewhere safe, such as a password manager or a printed copy.
recoveryCodes.saved: I saved these codes in a safe place

login.title: Sign in to Alice
login.sessionEnded: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
login.useApp: Use the code from your app

account.title: My account
account.languageHelp: Use the language switcher at the top of the page. Your choice is saved on your account.

password.title: Change password
password.mismatch: The two new passwords are different. Type the same password twice.
password.changed: Your password was changed. Your other sessions were signed out.

recovery.title: Recovery codes
recovery.help: Create a new set if you used most of your codes or think someone saw them. The old codes stop working.
recovery.active: Your new recovery codes are active.

code.title: Enter the setup code
code.help: The one-time setup code was shown when Alice was installed on the server.
code.label: Setup code
code.lost: Lost the code? Someone with administrator rights on the Alice server can create a new one.

language.title: Choose your language
language.label: Language for Alice and its emails

admin.title: Create the administrator account
admin.help: This account can do everything in Alice. It always signs in with a password and a code from an authenticator app.
admin.passwordHelp: At least 12 characters. A few unrelated words are easy to remember and hard to guess.
admin.passwordMismatch: The two passwords are different. Type the same password twice.

passphrase.title: Choose a recovery passphrase
passphrase.warning: This passphrase protects your backups. If you lose it, backups cannot be opened and nobody, including the vendor, can help.
passphrase.label: Recovery passphrase
passphrase.help: At least 16 characters. Write it on paper and keep it somewhere safe, away from this server.
passphrase.mismatch: The two passphrases are different. Type the same passphrase twice.

strength.tooShort: Too short: use at least 16 characters.

done.title: Alice is ready
done.help: Your administrator account and recovery passphrase are set. Next, add the people who will use Alice on the Users page.

license.title: Add a license
license.help: Send this Installation ID to your vendor to get a license file, then upload it here. You can also start with the 30-day evaluation and add the license later on the License page.
license.evaluateHelp: The evaluation started when Alice was installed. After 30 days, Alice pauses automatic tasks and changes to your servers until a license is uploaded. Your data is kept.

platform.title: Connect your servers
platform.help: Alice signs in to your servers with its own key. Prepare each server with the commands below; you can also do this later on the Servers page.
platform.addedFailed: The server was added, but Alice could not finish the first check. After the setup, open it on the Servers page.

users.title: Users
users.resetPasswordText: The person is signed out everywhere and must use this password at the next sign-in. Give it to them in a safe way.

fields.name: Full name
fields.initialPasswordHelp: At least 12 characters. The person sets up their authenticator app at the first sign-in.

confirm.resetMfaText: The person is signed out and must set up their authenticator app again at the next sign-in.
confirm.revokeText: All open sessions of this person end now. They can sign in again.
confirm.disableText: The person is signed out and cannot sign in until you enable the account again.
confirm.enableText: The person can sign in again with their password and authenticator app.

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.intro: API tokens let scripts and other tools use Alice on your behalf. A token never has more rights than your own role.
tokens.createdText: Copy this token now. It will not be shown again.
tokens.revokeText: Scripts that use this token stop working immediately.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.broken: Audit log integrity problem at entry {{seq}}.
audit.brokenHelp: Someone may have changed or deleted entries. Keep a copy of the export and contact your security team.
audit.headHash: Fingerprint of the latest entry (write it down to detect later changes):

actions.license_tampered: Stored license file changed outside Alice
actions.license_upload_invalid: License upload refused: not a valid license
actions.license_upload_invalid_signature: License upload refused: signature does not match
actions.license_upload_unsupported_format: License upload refused: newer file format
actions.license_upload_unknown_key: License upload refused: unknown signing key
actions.license_upload_revoked_key: License upload refused: signing key no longer trusted
actions.license_upload_wrong_installation: License upload refused: issued for another installation
actions.license_upload_older_than_installed: License upload refused: a newer license is installed
actions.clock_jump_cleared: Clock jump ended, the clock was corrected
actions.target_add_denied_license: Server not added: license limit reached or license expired
actions.hostkey_observed: Another new server fingerprint seen while the server is blocked
actions.job_tampered: Task changed outside Alice; not run
actions.job_confirmed: Paused task confirmed by an administrator

banner.evaluation_one: Evaluation mode: {{count}} day left, up to {{max_targets}} targets. To continue after that, an administrator adds a license on the License page.
banner.evaluation_other: Evaluation mode: {{count}} days left, up to {{max_targets}} targets. To continue after that, an administrator adds a license on the License page.
banner.evaluation_ended: The evaluation period has ended. Alice is now read-only for changes. Administrators can upload a license on the License page.
banner.expiry_warning_one: Your license expires in {{count}} day ({{valid_until}}). Send your Installation ID to your vendor to renew.
banner.expiry_warning_other: Your license expires in {{count}} days ({{valid_until}}). Send your Installation ID to your vendor to renew.
banner.grace: Your license expired on {{valid_until}}. Alice will stop automatic work on {{locks_at}} (168 hours after expiry). Contact your vendor now. Grace day {{grace_day}} of 7.
banner.locked: License expired. Automatic tasks are paused. Your data is safe and certificate expiry alerts still arrive by email. Administrators: upload a new license on the License page.
banner.tampered: License data was changed outside Alice, so Alice ignores the changed file. Upload the license file from your vendor again.
banner.clock_behind: The server clock changed unexpectedly (it says {{system_time}}, but Alice last saw {{last_seen}}). Alice is using the later date for license checks. Please correct the server time or contact your vendor.
banner.clock_jump_one: The server clock jumped forward by {{count}} day. For 24 hours Alice keeps using the previous time for license checks. Confirm the time is correct, or contact your vendor.
banner.clock_jump_other: The server clock jumped forward by {{count}} days. For 24 hours Alice keeps using the previous time for license checks. Confirm the time is correct, or contact your vendor.
banner.pending: A new license ({{license_id}}) starts on {{valid_from}}. The current license stays in use until then.
banner.over_limit: You use {{used}} of {{max}} licensed targets. You cannot add more until you are within the limit.
banner.limit_reached: You are using all {{max}} licensed targets. To add more, ask your vendor to increase your license.

installation.title: Installation ID
installation.help: Your vendor needs this ID to make a license for this installation. Copy it and email it to your vendor.

current.title: Current license
current.evaluation_one: Evaluation: {{count}} day left, up to {{max}} targets.
current.evaluation_other: Evaluation: {{count}} days left, up to {{max}} targets.
current.tampered: A stored license file was changed outside Alice and is ignored.

upload.title: Upload a license
upload.label: License file
upload.help: The file from your vendor's email, for example alice-license-yourcompany-20261001.alicelic.
upload.previewSummary: Licensed to {{customer}}. Up to {{max}} managed targets. Valid from {{from}} to {{until}}.
upload.alreadyExpired: This license has already expired. It is installed anyway; its own dates decide whether Alice is in the grace period or locked.
upload.pending: This license starts on {{from}}. The current license stays in use until then.
upload.activated: License activated. All features are available again.
upload.installedPending: The license is installed and starts on {{from}}.
upload.tooLarge: This file is too large to be a license.

warnings.file_unparseable: Alice could not read the authorized_keys file {{path}} of {{user}}; its keys are not listed.
warnings.keys_managed_elsewhere: The SSH server also asks a program (AuthorizedKeysCommand) for keys, so the key files may not be the whole picture. Alice will not change keys here.
warnings.keys_managed_elsewhere_user: The SSH server also asks a program (AuthorizedKeysCommand) for the keys of {{user}}, so the key files may not be the whole picture. Alice will not change keys here.
warnings.certificates_in_use: SSH certificates are in use on this server. Alice manages plain keys only.
warnings.pubkey_disabled: Public key sign-in is turned off on this server.
warnings.sshd_unreadable: Could not read the SSH server settings; only the default key files were checked.
warnings.strict_modes: The SSH server ignores this key file because its permissions are too open: {{path}}
warnings.unsupported_path: Alice cannot read a key file at this path: {{path}}
warnings.file_unreadable: Alice could not read this key file: {{path}}
warnings.file_too_large: This key file is larger than 1 MiB and was not read: {{path}}
warnings.directory_users_not_listed: Users from a directory service (LDAP or SSSD) are not listed.
warnings.unreadable_line: Line {{line_no}} of {{file_path}} could not be read. Alice leaves it unchanged.
warnings.too_many_users: This server has more user accounts than Alice lists, so some accounts were not scanned.
warnings.sshd_unreadable_user: Could not read the SSH server settings for {{user}}; only the default key files were checked.
warnings.unsupported_path_unnamed: Alice cannot read a key file at one of the paths that the SSH server uses.
warnings.unknown: Alice reported a note about this server that this version cannot describe.
warnings.incomplete: Alice reported a note about this server without its details.

targets.title: Servers
targets.empty: No servers yet. Prepare a server with the command below, then add it.

prepare.title: Prepare a server for Alice
prepare.help: Run these commands as root on the server. They create the user alice-svc, allow Alice's key, install alice-helper (copy it from the Alice bundle first) and give it a small, fixed set of permissions.

form.name: Name
form.hostHelp: Host name or IP address only. Enter the port in the next field.

targets.stillWorking: Alice is still working on this. Open the server's page in a minute to see the result.
targets.failedHelp: The server was added, but Alice could not finish the check. Fix the problem, then use Test connection on the server's page.
targets.added: Server added. Alice is reading its SSH keys.
targets.address: Alice signs in as {{user}} at {{host}}, port {{port}}.
targets.deleteHelp: Alice forgets the server and its keys. Nothing is changed on the server.
targets.noKeys: Alice has not found any SSH keys on this server yet.
targets.hostKeyChanged: The server's identity has changed, so Alice stopped all work on it. Ask your security team to confirm the change before you accept it.

hostKeys.confirmHelp: Alice received this fingerprint from {{host}}. Run the command below on the server and check that it shows the same fingerprint.
hostKeys.commandLabel: Command to run on the server
hostKeys.pendingNote: If you cancel, the server stays in the list as “Waiting for fingerprint confirmation”. You can confirm it later on the server's page.
hostKeys.repinHelp: Accept the new fingerprint only after your security team has confirmed that the server was reinstalled or its keys were replaced on purpose.
hostKeys.reasonHelp: At least 10 characters, for example the change ticket number. It is kept in the audit log.
hostKeys.acceptHelp: Choose this when the server was reinstalled or its keys were replaced on purpose.
hostKeys.keep: The server still shows the previous fingerprint
hostKeys.keepHelp: Choose this when the previous fingerprint is still the right one, for example because the connection reached another machine for a while. Alice keeps the previous fingerprint, unblocks the server and tests the connection again. If the server then shows a different key, you are asked to review it again.
hostKeys.noCandidate: Alice has not recorded a new fingerprint for this server.

sshKeys.title: SSH keys
sshKeys.intro: Every SSH key Alice found on your servers. A key used on several servers is listed once.
sshKeys.showMissing: Show keys that are no longer found
sshKeys.empty: No SSH keys match these filters.
sshKeys.removeTitle: Remove this key from the server?
sshKeys.removeHelp: Alice removes only this key from {{file}}. Other lines in the file stay as they are.
sshKeys.confirmLastRootKey: This is the last key of the root account. Remove it anyway.

flags.root_without_from: root key without a source address limit

jobs.blockedHelp: These changes were paused while the license was expired. Check each one, then run it or discard it.
jobs.blockedNotice: This task is paused and waits for an administrator to run it.
jobs.stopped: This task was stopped before it finished.
